Railroads are the only scalable income left — price it yourselves.","private_thought":"Auction. $200 leaves $213; a Connecticut hotel is $600 and VA+KY+IL+B&O mortgages ($410) only just cover it, and I'd mortgage the railroad I just bought. B&O alone is $25 and doesn't complete a set or block a color monopoly. p4 has 2 RRs and $739 so they'll pay up for a 3rd — let them drain cash. Bid later only if it's cheap (≤~$100); don't mortgage; don't trade Virginia or the reds. Priority remains Tennessee denial and Indiana only if hotel survival and a path to $450 remain."}
